values.binNote: Wiki states 50% AD but bin's tADRatio is 1.5 (150% AD); GarenQ#TotalDamage = BaseDamage + 1.5xad. This is a significant disagreement.

values.meaning: Window to use the empowered attack

mechanics.claim: The enhanced attack applies on-hit effects and can critically strike, but the bonus flat/AD damage from Q itself does not crit.
mechanics.quote: The enhanced attack will apply other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal (the bonus damage does not).

mechanics.claim: Decisive Strike resets Garen's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Decisive Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Garen's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage from the empowered attack applies life steal.
mechanics.quote: The bonus damage will also apply {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.

mechanics.claim: Using Decisive Strike locks Garen out of basic attacks for a short period, shortened by attack speed.
mechanics.quote: Decisive Strike'' locks '''Garen''' out of using basic attacks for a short period of time.<!--The enhanced attack or the ability itself?--> This is shortened with {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}}.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack has an uncancellable windup and lunges at the target, dealing bonus physical damage and silencing.
mechanics.quote: empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|4.5}} seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, {{tip|lunge}} at the target, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, and {{tip|silence}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
